name: miterlab-core-design-system
description: Lightweight, scalable core design system for Miterlab

scripts.docs:dev:with-bridge: sh -c 'if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8787/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm run dev -w @miterlab/docs; else npm run dev -w @miterlab/figma-bridge & BRIDGE_PID=$!; cleanup(){ kill $BRIDGE_PID 2>/dev/null || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; npm run dev -w @miterlab/docs; fi'
scripts.sync:mobile-core: npm run generate:button-inspection && npm run generate:input-inspection && npm run plugin:build && npm run docs:previews
